caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair set against a plain beige background. The chair has a dark brown, almost black frame with curved arms and legs and a decorative splat along the backrest. The seat is rendered in a light tan color with a woven, caned pattern, and the wood frame encloses this area. There are additional horizontal and diagonal stretchers connecting the legs for added structural support. Light pencil marks can be seen around the chair, especially near the back legs, suggesting underdrawing or preparatory sketch lines. The drawing is centered on the page, and a signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
